office_does: A State Representative is one of the 29th District's two members of the Washington House, voting on state law and budgets.
race_blurb: An open seat, vacated by Rep. Sharlett Mena's Senate run, between two Democrats: Tacoma Deputy Mayor Joe Bushnell and state equity-policy advisor Patrick Stickney. They differ most on public safety and on record versus renewal.

candidates.summary: Tacoma Deputy Mayor and Marine Corps combat veteran, running on universal healthcare, affordability and community safety.
highlights: Pledges to 'champion Universal Healthcare for all' [S1][S4]
Would make the rich pay their fair share while expanding the Working Families Tax Credit and the senior property-tax exemption [S4]
Calls for more community policing and says he led work to cut emergency response times [S4]
Co-sponsored Tacoma's 2026 ordinance barring civil immigration enforcement on city property [S6]
Endorsed by police and firefighter unions, the Association of Washington Business and Democratic officials [S1][S5]

taxes.basis: Says the rich should pay their fair share while cutting taxes for regular people through tax credits and exemptions.

safety.basis: Calls for more community policing and touts crime and response-time reductions, alongside more mental-health and addiction treatment.

experience.basis: Tacoma councilmember since 2021 and current Deputy Mayor, against a first-time candidate.

immigration.basis: Co-sponsored Tacoma's ordinance restricting civil immigration enforcement on city property and says 'we need to fight back.'

healthcare.basis: Repeatedly pledges to champion universal healthcare for all.

social.basis: Pledges to always vote to protect the right to choose and access to reproductive healthcare.

candidates.summary: Lawyer and senior policy advisor at the state Office of Equity, running on housing, worker and civil-rights protections, and a prevention-first approach to public safety.
highlights: Calls for co-response models, youth restorative justice and treatment to address root causes of crime [S4]
Would protect Apple Health and 'work toward real universal healthcare' [S4]
Former Department of Financial Institutions investor-protection examiner who would strengthen consumer protections [S1][S4]
Endorsed by the 29th LD and Pierce County Democrats, the Washington State Labor Council and Rep. Sharlett Mena [S1][S5]

safety.basis: Root causes, early intervention, co-response and restorative justice, with no enforcement planks.

climate.basis: Would combat climate-protection rollbacks and support a just transition to clean energy.

experience.basis: No elected office beyond precinct committee officer, but a state-agency policy professional, running against the Deputy Mayor.

immigration.basis: Supports resources and protections for immigrants and refugees and opposes federal overreach, in general terms.

healthcare.basis: Would protect Apple Health and 'work toward' universal healthcare.

tech.basis: Would protect the data privacy of Apple Health users.
